state.seed_assertion: Continuity testing should only be performed on de-energized circuits to avoid false positive results from the supply voltage.

sentences.1: Continuity testing should only be performed on de-energized circuits to avoid false positive results from the supply voltage.
sentences.2: Continuity checks are useful for wiring verification but only with the circuit de-energised.
sentences.3: Trying to run a continuity test on a live 24 VDC circuit will give you a beep regardless of the fault because the meter's test current is swamped by the supply.
sentences.4: Using continuity mode on a live circuit produces false positive 'good' results due to the supply voltage overwhelming the meter's test current.
sentences.5: Using continuity mode on a live circuit and getting a false 'good' result from the supply voltage.
sentences.6: Continuity testing should only be performed when a circuit is de-energized and verified safe.
sentences.7: Voltage tests are performed on energized circuits, while continuity and resistance tests are performed only on de-energized circuits.
sentences.8: Use continuity only when the circuit is de-energized and verified safe.
sentences.9: Near-field H probes can be used to detect ground noise, EMI, and poor switching power supply designs from a distance of half an inch or more.
sentences.10: Understanding fundamental physics and transmission line theory can significantly aid in troubleshooting intermittent faults, particularly in switching power supplies.
sentences.11: Aliasing can occur when high-frequency, high-power signals from power supplies and drivers appear in other systems or at different time scales.
sentences.12: A quality multimeter is the most essential tool for PLC troubleshooting to measure voltages, verify continuity, and check signal current.
